name: Document Print Leg
description: The PRINT leg of print-and-mail as its own settlement unit (the per-leg model, October MVP runbook v3 section 1.2). A print kernel prints one document, and the unit settles at tier 1 on the kernel-signed completion (execution_completed, bound by receipt.kernel_signed) with no execution_failed and no simulated event, as its committed program requires. Courier, carrier and label evidence belong to their own units, never to this unit's bundle: a TEST-mode carrier event is simulated, and one simulated event refuses the whole bundle. HONEST LIMIT: the record is the print host's own and device-signed; nothing independent of the host corroborates the print at this tier, and the document's content is not bound (evidence Q-E5).

tier0.description: The authenticated floor (evidence Q-E1): the operator's committed package declares the job (decl.self_attested), the bundle is signed by the unit's session key under the funded device key with every event bound to the unit and its challenge nonce, and the print started (execution_started). Tier 0 never releases on chain (Tier0NotEvidence); it gives a failed print a signed verdict.

tier1.description: The print-leg release tier: tier 0 plus the kernel-signed success receipt (execution_completed, receipt.kernel_signed). The committed program also requires execution_failed to be absent and no simulated event; event absence is a program predicate, never a CSD binding.
